title: DFRP
body:
# Discord Rich Presence for DiamondFire

Small Java utility mod that shows what you're doing on the DiamondFire Minecraft server in your Discord status.

### Shows
- Current node you're on
- Plot you're in (when applicable)
- Your current mode (Playing / Building / Coding)

### Roadmap
- Private node support
- Per-plot overrides & full customization of presence text/assets
- Optional mode-based toggles (e.g., disable presence while coding)

### Status
- Work-in-progress
